topic: Deep Learning and Neural Network Foundations

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a drawback of using a plain ANN for image data that CNNs specifically address?
options: Plain ANN requires a very large number of parameters because every pixel is connected to every neuron in the next layer
Plain ANN cannot learn any non‑linear relationships in image data
Plain ANN automatically reduces image size without any extra layers
Plain ANN uses convolutional filters to extract local features
questions.correctAnswer: Plain ANN requires a very large number of parameters because every pixel is connected to every neuron in the next layer
questions.explanation: A fully connected ANN treats each pixel independently, leading to an explosion of weights for high‑resolution images. CNNs address this by using local receptive fields (convolutional layers) and weight sharing, dramatically reducing the number of parameters while preserving spatial information.

questions.questionText: Which sequence correctly describes the ordered steps of forward propagation in the CNN model described in the session?
options: Read image → Convolution → Activation function → Pooling → Fully connected layer → Loss calculation
Read image → Convolution → Pooling → Activation function → Fully connected layer → Loss calculation
Read image → Convolution → Activation function → Fully connected layer → Pooling → Loss calculation
Read image → Pooling → Convolution → Activation function → Fully connected layer → Loss calculation
questions.correctAnswer: Read image → Convolution → Activation function → Pooling → Fully connected layer → Loss calculation
questions.explanation: The forward propagation described starts with reading the input image, then applying a convolutional layer to extract features, followed by an activation function (e.g., ReLU) to introduce non‑linearity, then a pooling layer to reduce spatial dimensions, after which the feature maps are flattened and fed into a fully connected layer, and finally the loss function is computed.

questions.questionText: Before feeding an image into the CNN, which preprocessing steps must be applied to meet the model requirements?
options: Resize to 28x28 pixels and convert to grayscale
Resize to 32x32 pixels and keep RGB channels
Normalize pixel values to [0,1] without resizing
Crop to central 28x28 region and keep original color format
questions.correctAnswer: Resize to 28x28 pixels and convert to grayscale
questions.explanation: The CNN expects input images of size 28 × 28 with a single channel. Therefore any image must be resized to 28 × 28 pixels and converted from color (RGB) to grayscale before being fed to the network.
